info.name: Atlassian Get the Root Directory of the Main Branch

params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

params.name: format
params.description: Instead of returning the file's contents, return the (json) meta data for it.

items.docs: The GET operation on /repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/src endpoint in the Atlassian Bitbucket Repositories API retrieves the contents of the root directory from the main branch of a specified repository. By providing the workspace identifier and repository slug in the path parameters, this endpoint returns a paginated list of files and directories located at the repository's root level, including metadata such as file names, paths, sizes, and commit information.
